why_ai: AI drafts curricula from SME material; only some live facilitation stays human.
why_clarity: L&D cannot link training to performance outcomes, so value stays unproven.
why_digital: SME knowledge becomes LMS courseware, with some in-person facilitation.

why_ai: Rubric-based grading of written and video responses is a direct LLM substitution.
why_clarity: Codified rubrics applied to thousands of standardized submissions.
why_digital: Digital submissions in, scores out, graded remotely.

why_ai: Accreditation determines whether credits count toward licences, an accountable gatekeeping role.
why_clarity: Written standards guide reviews, though programme quality takes years to show.
why_digital: Provider documentation reviewed on screen; accreditation is a mandated domestic relationship.

why_ai: Mandated content and completion tracking are commodity e-learning AI can generate.
why_clarity: Regulations specify content, populations and schedules with auditable completion records.
why_digital: Regulatory text in, e-learning modules and completion records out.

why_ai: AI-generated on-demand content directly threatens licensed course catalogues.
why_clarity: Skills mapping and consumption analytics are defined, but course value is subjective.
why_digital: Courses and consumption data delivered as an online subscription.

why_ai: Unique joined workforce data and internal trust, though analysis itself automates.
why_clarity: Programme evaluation lacks agreed success measures and results lag.
why_digital: Workforce data analyzed on screen; programmes partly delivered in person.

why_ai: Sensitive live workshops depend on a trusted facilitator in the room.
why_clarity: Near-zero measurement of whether attitudes or behaviour change.
why_digital: Mostly live facilitated workshops, some off-the-shelf e-learning.

why_ai: Network curation and outcomes research ride an employer service contract.
why_clarity: Retention and mobility outcomes are measurable but take years to appear.
why_digital: Participation and HR data in, ROI reports and programme admin online.

why_ai: Training fits into shifts on site, but mobile content is easily AI-generated.
why_clarity: Procedural job skills repeat across large deskless workforces.
why_digital: Mobile microlearning delivered to workers on floors without computers.

why_ai: Certifications the profession hires against hold value; benchmark research is substitutable.
why_clarity: Psychometric exam development is codified; practice research is less checkable.
why_digital: Survey and exam data in, reports and certifications out online.

why_ai: Converting SME knowledge into courseware is exactly what generative AI does.
why_clarity: Design methods are codified, but learning effectiveness is rarely verified.
why_digital: SME documents in, digital courseware out, contracted remotely.

why_ai: Longitudinal posting archive is a moat, though LLMs ease taxonomy building.
why_clarity: Parsing postings into a skills ontology repeats across hundreds of millions of records.
why_digital: Job postings and profiles in, analytics subscription out.

why_ai: AI synthesizes practice research; only survey panels and citation credibility remain.
why_clarity: Annual benchmark surveys repeat, but maturity models are subjective.
why_digital: Surveys in, membership research reports out online.

why_ai: Credible independent causal evaluation for budget defence needs methodological judgment.
why_clarity: Each study is bespoke and impact attribution is slow and contested.
why_digital: Client performance data in, impact studies out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Recommendation and skills inference models are standard ML that AI tooling accelerates.
why_clarity: Model features ship with measurable engagement and accuracy metrics.
why_digital: Platform usage data in, software features and reports out.

why_ai: Physical machine and lockout skills are taught hands-on beside equipment.
why_clarity: SOP-based procedures with observable competency checks on the floor.
why_digital: Training happens on noisy plant floors with equipment, paper SOPs and buddies.

why_ai: Predictable cross-department task sequences with triggers are workflow automation.
why_clarity: Defined tasks, owners and deadlines repeat for every new hire.
why_digital: HR records in, provisioning and task workflows out, bought as SaaS.

why_ai: Social learning and cohort design need human judgment, but delivery is screen-based.
why_clarity: Informal learning loss and cross-cultural gaps have no agreed fix or metric.
why_digital: Training runs entirely over video and LMS across timezones.

why_ai: AI role-play and call coaching substitute much rep training.
why_clarity: Quota attainment and win rates in CRM give a measurable outcome loop.
why_digital: CRM data and content in, mostly virtual coaching out, with some kickoffs.

why_ai: Generative AI makes scenario and conversational practice libraries cheap to build.
why_clarity: Scoring rubrics exist, but scenario realism is a matter of design taste.
why_digital: Software simulations sold and delivered online.

why_ai: Legally defensible validity evidence for employment decisions is hard for AI entrants to match.
why_clarity: Psychometric validation methods are codified with norm-based scoring.
why_digital: Assessments administered and scored online.

why_ai: Acquisition calls are high-stakes judgment, but screening and modelling automate.
why_clarity: Standard diligence models, but each deal differs and pays off slowly.
why_digital: Data-room analysis on screen; deals close through relationships.
